BiblicalUsage: Yehud is the Aramaic word for Judah, the land and the people of the Jews in the days of Daniel and Ezra. In Ezra 5:1, prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Judah reminds me Scripture happened somewhere, not in the abstract.
